changes.label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
changes.new_text: This world is full of POKéMON. They share our forests, our seas, and our everyday lives. / I study them here in HOENN. Lately, the weather has been changing, and so have their habitats. / Every journey brings a new discovery. Even familiar paths can surprise you! / Your journey will begin with two partners. Most TRAINERS here battle in pairs, so teamwork matters from the start. / Our POKéMON CENTERS will help you prepare. Their TUTORS teach moves, change NATURES, and adjust EVs for free. / They can also suggest complete BATTLE SETS. Try your own ideas, too! / A free LEVELER brings your party to the current level cap. Each BADGE lets your team reach higher. / You can spend your time exploring and learning how your partners work together. / HOENN's TRAINERS will give you a real challenge. A loss can teach you something a victory cannot. / But there is more to this region than its GYMS. Listen to its people. Watch its POKéMON. / I wonder what you will discover together!

changes.label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
changes.new_text: Oh, hi! You there! Can I get you to massage my shoulder? / …Yes, there! Ouch, ouch! Oooh, that feels great! / My name's {STR_VAR_1}. I take karate training, but my body's not built to take the abuse… / I decided I'll battle POKéMON and toughen myself up. / You're {PLAYER}{KUN}, aren't you? I've heard you're a tough TRAINER! / Listen, can I get you to give me advice?

changes.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode0
changes.new_text: Oh, really? You will? Awesome! Wicked! Awoooh! / Oh… I'm sorry… I'm so happy, I'm crying… / I'm planning my own practice team. Should I train for Level 50 or Open Level?

changes.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode1
changes.new_text: Yay! Great! / I want to set a goal for my practice team! Level 50 or Open Level? / Which would be perfect for me?

changes.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode2
changes.new_text: Thank you! Here's my first question! / For my own practice team, should I aim for Level 50 or Open Level? / Which is more suitable for me?

changes.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode3
changes.new_text: Really? I can't believe you'll advise me! I… I'm so happy… / I need a goal for my practice team, but I can't decide… / Level 50 or Open Level? Which could someone like me manage?

changes.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode4
changes.new_text: Okay, I need you to decide something for me. / I'm planning my own practice team. Should I aim for Level 50 or Open Level? / Which do you think would suit me, {PLAYER}{KUN}?

changes.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode5
changes.new_text: Thank you! That's more like it! Let's start with an easy one! / I need a training goal for my team. Level 50 or Open Level? / Me being a busy guy, which should I gear up for?

changes.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode6
changes.new_text: Yay! I knew you'd have a big heart, {PLAYER}! / Drum roll, please! My first question is about my practice team! / Level 50 or Open Level? Which suits me more?

changes.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
changes.new_text: Oh… I'm delighted! / Please help me set a goal for my own practice team. / Which would be most suitable for me? Level 50 or Open Level?

changes.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8
changes.new_text: Hieeeeh! {PLAYER} said yes! I won't be able to sleep tonight… / Then, here's my question! For my practice team, what is right for me? / Level 50 or Open Level?

changes.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode9
changes.new_text: Oh, yeah! That's a solid reply! Excellent, I might add! / Now for my own practice team… Should I train for Level 50 or Open Level?

changes.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
changes.new_text: Yippee! I'll buy you a boat for that! / Of course I'm lying again! But… Thank you, master! / Should I train my own team for Level 50 or Open Level? Decide for me, master!

changes.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11
changes.new_text: That's it! {PLAYER}, you've got the spirit! / My practice team needs a destination! I leave it to your inspiration! / Level 50 or Open Level there be, which is the one that's good for me?

changes.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode12
changes.new_text: Lucky, yeah, woohoo! Should I pop a question to you? / My practice team needs a goal to pursue. Level 50 or Open Level? It's up to you!

changes.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode13
changes.new_text: Thank you. Mighty good of you! …Cough! Cough! / Oogh, I have to toughen up quick… My POKéMON need a training goal, too. / Level 50 or Open Level? Which should I aim for?

changes.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode14
changes.new_text: Th-thank you… Please don't stare. I'm getting all flustered. / I need a goal for my practice team. Level 50 or Open Level? / Which should I attempt?

changes.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode15
changes.new_text: You really are accepting me? I don't wish to celebrate prematurely. / If it is true, I apologize. Now, I need your advice. / For my own practice team, what would be worthy of me? Level 50 or Open Level?

changes.label: MatchCall_Text_Scott6
changes.new_text: SCOTT: Hi, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}! All eight BADGES! The LEAGUE is waiting for you. / If you want another challenge, visit the CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT at the BATTLE FRONTIER. / The LILYCOVE ferry opens that route with six BADGES. You've already earned your passage! / I hope to see you over there!

changes.label: MatchCall_Text_Drake
changes.new_text: DRAKE: That voice… {PLAYER}, is it? You sound well… / The CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT tests how long a crew can keep winning. / Here at the LEAGUE, you face us in succession. Two worthy challenges for a seasoned TRAINER. / When the sea brings you back, we'll be ready.

changes.label: MatchCall_Text_May8
changes.new_text: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, hi. / MT. PYRE is a memorial to POKéMON whose lives have ended. / GHOST POKéMON gather there. I wonder if they feel at home among the memories.

changes.label: MatchCall_Text_Brendan8
changes.new_text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! / MT. PYRE is a memorial to POKéMON whose lives have ended. / There are GHOST POKéMON everywhere. I'm keeping my voice down while I explore.

changes.label: MatchCall_NegativeBattleText3
changes.new_text: Hey there, {PLAYER}! It's me, {STR_VAR_1}! / I just got cleaned in a battle. I need to rethink how my partners work together!

changes.label: MatchCall_NegativeBattleText4
changes.new_text: Hey, {PLAYER}. {STR_VAR_1} here. / I tried another battle yesterday, but I couldn't pull out the win. / I'm trying a different lead pair. Okay, catch you later.

changes.label: MatchCall_NegativeBattleText10
changes.new_text: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, hello… This is {STR_VAR_1}. / I lost a battle earlier. I'm going to review our moves with a TUTOR. / See you around.

changes.label: gBirchDexRatingText_Cancel
changes.new_text: Another time, then! I always enjoy hearing about your discoveries.

changes.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan110
changes.new_text: Your field notes are really taking shape. This is an impressive POKéDEX!

changes.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan130
changes.new_text: Try returning to familiar places with a new ROD or a field skill. You may meet different POKéMON!

changes.label: gBirchDexRatingText_DexCompleted
changes.new_text: Congratulations! Your HOENN POKéDEX is complete!

changes.label: MoveTutor_Text_ThisMoveCanOnlyBeLearnedOnce
changes.new_text: I can give this lesson only once. Shall we begin?

changes.label: EventTicket_Text_SouthernIslandSailBack
changes.new_text: Aye, mate, this island has a quiet all its own. / Ready to sail back to LILYCOVE?

changes.label: gText_FollowerDefault
changes.new_text: {STR_VAR_1} pauses to take in the surroundings.

changes.label: Text_NothingButPokemonBooks
changes.new_text: Every book on the shelf is about POKéMON.

changes.label: EmeraldChampions_Text_ExplainBattleSets
changes.new_text: A Battle Set prepares moves, Nature, Ability, EVs, and a held item. / Transformation items, such as Mega Stones, must be found separately.

changes.label: EmeraldChampions_Text_FormGiftFull
changes.new_text: There's no room in your party or PC. I'll keep your partner here until a space opens up.

changes.label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
changes.new_text: Any compatible partner can use SECRET POWER in the field. / Look for marked trees, thick bushes, and small indents in rock walls.

changes.label: Route120_Text_LeonelPostBattle
changes.new_text: Travelers with five BADGES have spotted OGERPON in this route's grass. / It's a rare sight. SWEET SCENT can help draw out the local discoveries.

changes.label: Route111_Text_BrookePostRematch
changes.new_text: I should ask a CENTER TUTOR about moves that give my partners more ways to help each other.

changes.label: Route111_Text_WiltonDefeat
changes.new_text: My defenses weren't enough…

changes.label: Route111_Text_BrookeIntro
changes.new_text: Every partner has a job. Some make an opening; others charge through it. / Which one will you answer first?

changes.label: Route115_Text_TimothyDefeat
changes.new_text: You set the pace of that match!

changes.label: Route119_Text_DonaldIntro
changes.new_text: A swarm doesn't have to stand still! Mine can slow you down while keeping the pressure on. / Try to keep up!

changes.label: Route119_Text_DonaldDefeat
changes.new_text: My swarm couldn't hold you back!

changes.label: Route119_Text_DonaldPostBattle
changes.new_text: ELECTROWEB slows the opposing pair. I need to make better use of the time that buys.

changes.label: Route119_Text_GregIntro
changes.new_text: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE! I've copied a few tricks from the wind and the light. / Let's see if they hold up in battle!

changes.label: Route119_Text_GregDefeat
changes.new_text: My reflections weren't enough…

changes.label: Route119_Text_GregPostBattle
changes.new_text: REFLECT and LIGHT SCREEN soften attacks. TAILWIND helps us act sooner. / Putting those tricks together takes practice!

changes.label: Route119_Text_KentIntro
changes.new_text: See that darting shape between the trees? That's my partner warming up! / The forest never stands still. Neither do we!

changes.label: Route119_Text_KentDefeat
changes.new_text: You caught up with us!

changes.label: Route119_Text_KentPostBattle
changes.new_text: NINJASK gathers Speed, then BATON PASS can hand it to a teammate. / The tricky part is choosing when to make the handoff.

changes.label: Route119_Text_JacksonDefeat
changes.new_text: You handled our charged-up team!

changes.label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostBattle
changes.new_text: ELECTRIC TERRAIN changes the ground under our feet. The rain changes the weather above it. / A RANGER watches both.

changes.label: Route119_Text_CatherinePostBattle
changes.new_text: Being prepared means having more than one plan. The weather can change before you finish packing!

changes.label: Route119_Text_YasuIntro
changes.new_text: A ninja watches for an opening. My partners can make one with speed, strength, or a well-timed trick. / Will you leave us a gap?

changes.label: Route119_Text_YasuDefeat
changes.new_text: My techniques fell short…

changes.label: Route119_Text_YasuPostBattle
changes.new_text: A ninja must learn when to strike and when to retreat. My partners and I still have work to do.

changes.label: Route119_Text_TakashiIntro
changes.new_text: I trained in this rain until you couldn't hear my footsteps. / Now let's see how quietly my partners can take you by surprise!

changes.label: Route119_Text_TakashiDefeat
changes.new_text: So much for my surprise attack!

changes.label: Route119_Text_TakashiPostBattle
changes.new_text: Concealment only lasts until the battle starts. After that, I have to rely on my partners.

changes.label: Route119_Text_FabianIntro
changes.new_text: My rhythm is thunder, voice, and wind. Every partner adds something to the band. / Try to break the chorus!

changes.label: Route119_Text_FabianDefeat
changes.new_text: That brought the house down!

changes.label: Route119_Text_RachelIntro
changes.new_text: My parasol is for more than show. My partners know how to make the most of a rainy day. / Shall we?

changes.label: Route119_Text_RachelDefeat
changes.new_text: Oh! My forecast was wrong…

changes.label: Route119_Text_RachelPostBattle
changes.new_text: A good rain team needs a plan for clear skies, too. I'll remember that on my next walk.

changes.label: Route120_Text_JenniferIntro
changes.new_text: An ABILITY can change a whole battle. Mine have a few surprises for you. / Ready to discover them?

changes.label: Route120_Text_JenniferDefeat
changes.new_text: Your team surprised me!

changes.label: Route120_Text_JenniferPostBattle
changes.new_text: PRANKSTER gives many status moves priority. Think about what a partner can do with that opening.

changes.label: Route120_Text_ClarissaDefeat
changes.new_text: You weathered that battle well!

changes.label: Route120_Text_ClarissaPostBattle
changes.new_text: I love the rain, but I can't count on it forever. Even a parasol needs folding sometimes.

changes.label: Route123_Text_WendyPostBattle
changes.new_text: A good test gives both TRAINERS something to think about. You've certainly given me plenty!

changes.label: Route123_Text_BraxtonPostBattle
changes.new_text: You did those BADGES proud. Wherever you go next, keep that determination.

changes.label: Route127_Text_AthenaDefeat
changes.new_text: You got the better of me!

changes.label: Route133_Text_WarrenIntro
changes.new_text: I like finding my own way to win. MUSHARNA and TORTERRA help me do just that!

changes.label: Route134_Text_MarleyIntro
changes.new_text: Fast or slow, every partner needs its moment. Mine won't let an opening go to waste!

changes.label: Route134_Text_MarleyDefeat
changes.new_text: Oh! Thoroughly beaten!

changes.label: Route134_Text_MarleyPostBattle
changes.new_text: A slow partner can still hit hard. The trick is getting it safely into position.

changes.label: Route118_Text_DeandreIntro
changes.new_text: Go, go, go! Every partner, ready for action!

changes.label: Route118_Text_DeandreDefeat
changes.new_text: Come in, POKéMON! Is everybody okay?!

changes.label: gTVThePokemonBattleSeminarText01
changes.new_text: And it used the move {STR_VAR_3} on the {STR_VAR_2}… / Let's look at the damage options, {STR_VAR_1}!

changes.label: gTVThePokemonBattleSeminarText02
changes.new_text: The TRAINER's {STR_VAR_1} also knew

changes.label: gTVThePokemonBattleSeminarText06
changes.new_text: Our damage comparison suggests {STR_VAR_1} could hit harder than {STR_VAR_2}. / More damage is not always the goal! Accuracy, side effects, and catching a wild POKéMON can change the best choice. / Consider the whole field before you choose. Until next time!

changes.label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_RepeatedAppeals
changes.new_text: Repeating the same appeals cost it the JUDGE's attention. / {STR_VAR_1} could try varying the routine next time to keep the audience guessing.

changes.label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_ValiantEffortButLost
changes.new_text: {STR_VAR_1} finished last, but kept giving the performance everything. / There is plenty to learn from that effort. We hope to see a comeback!

changes.label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_LastInBothRounds
changes.new_text: It finished last in both rounds of judging. / {STR_VAR_1} and the {STR_VAR_2} have a fresh challenge: a routine that lets their best qualities shine.

changes.label: gText_EmeraldChampionsExplainTools
changes.new_text: The Poké Vial fully restores your party outside battle. / It holds one dose. Every Pokémon Center refills it for free. / The Leveler raises your whole party to the current level cap. It never runs out. / The Repel Spray keeps wild Pokémon away for 500 steps per use. Fishing, Rock Smash and Sweet Scent still work. / The Tutor by the PC helps with moves, Nature, EVs and Battle Sets. / The Vendor supplies battle held items for free. Every Center has both services. / The Flight Beacon calls a flier once you have the badge for Fly.

changes.label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Woman
changes.new_text: I heard you can see PIKACHU in the southern part of the SAFARI ZONE. I may have wandered too far!

changes.label: Route128_Text_WayneIntro
changes.new_text: I want to visit EVER GRANDE, so I brought a partner that can use WATERFALL to crest the falls.

changes.label: Route128_Text_WaynePostBattle
changes.new_text: Awww, phooey! My partner can use WATERFALL, but I still need the SOOTOPOLIS GYM BADGE!

changes.label: Route111_Text_MakingRoomUseTMToMakeYourOwn
changes.new_text: I'm making my own room here with SECRET POWER. A partner that can learn it can use it in the field. / Want an ULTRA BALL for the road?

changes.label: gTVSecretBaseVisitText09
changes.new_text: Sigh… I've got to hand it to {STR_VAR_1}. Those POKéMON were a formidable team! / That the {STR_VAR_2} knew the move {STR_VAR_3}… It shows you what sort of a TRAINER {STR_VAR_1} is. / Certainly, it was quite a lesson!
